text:
ash: quick ideawe keep missing followups. propose a short "remediation sprint" pattern: 7-day box, single owner per action, verifier, and a required evidence link at close. minimal fields shown below.

mina: i like timeboxing. what does the timeline look like?

owen: default timeline: publish postmortem -> day0 owner assigned -> day1 triage note -> day3 progress update -> day7 verification+close. auto-escalate at day3 if blocked.

gabi: can we make the evidence a hard requirement? force-close without link should be rejected and go to steward. avoid fuzzy closures.

ash: template (one-line fields so it's easy to copy into tracker):
- Owner: <name>
- Verifier: <name>
- SLA-tier: rapid|standard|extended
- Due: <date or tier>
- One-line fix: <what we change>
- Evidence: <metric/canary link>
- Rollback: <one-line>
- Recurrence-tag: <e.g., cache-warm, db-reconnect>

mina: +1 to recurrence tags. also recommend a tiny "why this might recur" sentence so we capture hypotheses.
owen: automation: oncall-bot creates a sprint board and DMs owners on day1 and day3. if no update by day3, shadow owner becomes active.
oncall-bot: automated: created sprint item RS-31624 for incident 3162468001, owner @ash, reminders scheduled day1/day3. link: https://tracker.example/RS-31624

gabi: comms template for execs: 2 lines: 1) top risk action + ETA, 2) what we need (e.g., prod rollback window). keeps inboxes short.

ash: operational nit: infra changes often need procurementallow extended SLA for those by default. set guidance in the template.

mina: propose a two-week pilot on all postmortems with >2 actions. measure median time-to-close and percent closed with evidence.
owen: i'll add a tiny dashboard with counts by recurrence-tag so PMs can see patterns.

ash: next steps: 1) mina to own the pilot, 2) owen to prototype board+dash, 3) gabi to draft evidence checklist. i'll add the template to /incidents/process and send a PR.

mina: sounds good. push any edits here or open a PR. :thumbsup:
